obfuscation_indicators: when pricing and terms are favorable
risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified, detailing cash flows, debt capacity, maturities, covenant compliance, and capital allocation. The tone is confident and liquidity-focused, but relies on forward-looking assurances and conditional language around dividends, acquisitions, repurchases, and future cash generation. Key risks include leverage and covenant constraints, guaranteed preneed obligations, trust investment performance, and exposure to changing cremation trends.
